

```{python}
import altair as alt

import charts.datacenters
```

```{python}
#| label: first-companies
# load data
import wrangle.datacenters as wd
import wrangle.water as ww

# pin the owner -> color assignment so both charts use the same scale
owners = sorted(
    set(wd.high_power_low_density()["owner_clean"].dropna())
    | set(wd.enriched_centers()["owner_clean"].dropna())
)
owner_scale = alt.Scale(domain=owners, scheme="tableau20")

brush = alt.selection_point(
    fields = ["owner_clean"],
)
condition = alt.when(brush).then(
    alt.Color("owner_clean:N", scale=owner_scale, title="Owner")
).otherwise(alt.value("grey"))
company_bars = charts.datacenters.site_concentration().encode(color=condition)
```

```{python}
#| label: companies with maps
#|

points = (
    alt.Chart(wd.enriched_centers().dropna(subset=["Latitude", "Longitude"]))
    .mark_circle(opacity=0.7, strokeWidth=1)
    .encode(
        size=alt.Size(
            "Current power (MW):Q",
            scale=alt.Scale(range=[20, 1000]),
            legend=alt.Legend(title="Power Capacity (MW)"),
        ),
        color=condition,
        longitude="Longitude:Q",
        latitude="Latitude:Q",
        tooltip=["Name:N", "Address:N", f"Current power (MW):Q", alt.Tooltip("owner_clean:N", title="Owner")],
    )
)
water_stress = (charts.water.baseline_stress_choropleth() + points).properties(
    width=800,
    height=500,
    title="Baseline Water Stress by US State with Current AI Data Center Locations",
)


alt.hconcat(water_stress | company_bars).add_params(brush)
```
